findings.body: The SDK completion requirement is still unmet. In packages/sdk/src/session-events.ts:109–114, a typing event without orderedEnvelope still updates typing state and returns true before an ordered baseline exists. apps/core/test/unit/control/sdk-transport.test.ts:660–663 and apps/core/test/unit/channels/app.test.ts:518 explicitly require this legacy behavior. Remove that compatibility path and update its tests so the SDK always requires ordering information. This work is part of the stated fix and has no demonstrated dependency on another task.

findings.body: The only changed test injects a snapshot through a mocked memory service (lines 53–56) and directly calls the notification helper (lines 77–83). The new Berlin assertion also passes with the previous snapshot-aware renderer, so it cannot detect restoration of the removed fallback. Neither completion item has the required Playwright user flow through a running API and real database. package.json:86 runs only unit and integration suites, and the CLI coverage mocks the API at apps/core/test/unit/cli/memory-review-command.test.ts:15–24. Add meaningful end-to-end coverage for both contracts and include it in the repository test command.
